findings.evidence: and fifty years of Tom Vane were floating in front of the men who had known him.
findings.diagnosis: Lands at the emotional apex and names/measures the freight instead of letting the white hull on flat water carry it; tips the peak toward elegy, a more consoling effect than the earned quiet recognition.

findings.evidence: Not to Rennie. To the boat, maybe, or the man who built her.
findings.diagnosis: 'or the man who built her' reaches past the concrete for pathos; the bare 'Not to Rennie' was enough.

findings.evidence: No one cheered; it was not that kind of morning.
findings.diagnosis: The first clause shows; the second tells the reader how to weight it.
